'''Chi Eekway Papanoida''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She was the daughter of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]].

==Biography==
===Clone Wars===
[[File:N_Papanoida_And_His_Family.png|thumb|left|210px|Chi with her family]]
Sometime during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Chi Eekway Papanoida and her sister [[Che Amanwe Papanoida/Legends|Che Amanwe Papanoida]] were kidnapped by [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] at their [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] home. He was aided by a [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] assistant, who grabbed an unsuspecting Papanoida, followed by her sister. The two were separated, and with the help of [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Chi Eekway Papanoida was rescued from Separatist clutches.

Papanoida did contact her father at the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]] during the performance of [[Squid Lake/Legends|''Squid Lake'']] to receive important information for the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalists]]. She was accompanied by her friend and advisor [[Terr Taneel/Legends|Terr Taneel]], who was actually keeping a close eye on her; Taneel secretly harbored fears Papanoida had ambitions to politically outshine her.

Chi was a member of the [[Delegation of 2000|group of senators]], including [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who had grown worried of the immense power [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had been given by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Chi was particularly alarmed by the news that the new [[Moff/Legends|governors]], appointed by the Chancellor via the [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|Sector Governance Decree]], were being arriving in their assigned sectors with contingents of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. She was particularly worried that these regiments were designed for the governors' protection rather the people's. Senator Amidala suggested they propose the ideas to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], but Eekway urged them to be patient. The rest of the senators believed they should see what they could accomplish in the Senate first, in the hopes that Palpatine would see that there was opposition to his methods.

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Papanoida_at_the_opera.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Papanoida converses with her father at the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]].]]
As a young and impetuous Pantoran, Senator Chi Eekway Papanoida's sphere of control included areas of space dominated by unallied trader guilds that often stretched the limits of Republic law. She learned valuable lessons trying to govern citizens who cherished their frontier spirit. It spoke well of her skills to have earned the respect of a people well known for their disdain for government. Her devotion to [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] spirituality&mdash;visible in details found in the ornate [[molf]]-tasseled overcloak she wore&mdash;helped her earn support and respect. Papanoida's near-supernatural levels of empathy helped her quell even the most contentious of political disputes. Perhaps her tenure during a time when an overriding Republic was drawing power away from the individual sectors colored the views of her fiercely independent constituents.

For her exposure to a rough-and-tumble culture of law-benders, Papanoida learned the art of the bluff and a diplomatic style more confrontational than the usual measured approaches found in the Senate. In heated exchanges, she has even been known to drop veiled hints at the power her allies could bring to a dispute.<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chi Eekway Papanoida was portrayed by one of [[George Lucas]]'s daughters, [[Katie Lucas]]. She was voiced in the ''Clone Wars'' by [[Nika Futterman]].<ref name="Sphere Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode304.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Sphere of Influence}}</ref>

The design notes that accompanied the original concepts of Chi Eekway's costumes described her as a "Mystic Senator." Iain McCaig illustrated these initial concepts, using his talent for capturing likenesses to place the Senator's eventual performer into the artwork.<ref name="db" />

As recently as [[June]] [[2008]], Papanoida's [[Species/Legends|species]] was given as [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]].<ref name="archive">{{DB|character|chieekway|Eekway, Chi}}</ref> An exclusive action figure produced in 2006 also depicts and labels her as a Twi'lek, though this is no longer canon.<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Saga Collection|pack=Lucas Collector's Set|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TSClucascollectorset.asp}}</ref>

The ''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' mistakenly identifies her homeworld as [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]].
